expectations.text: Identifies hostile-origin or DNS-rebinding access as the security boundary
expectations.evidence: Calls the original browser/DNS-rebinding path the confirmed in-scope vulnerability.

expectations.text: Classifies same-user configured plugin token inheritance as hardening
expectations.evidence: Classifies it as informational or out_of_scope_hardening because no new authority crosses a trust boundary.

expectations.text: Classifies false startup success as a non-security lifecycle defect
expectations.evidence: Classifies premature startup success as non_security_defect and unrelated_bug.

expectations.text: Separates adjacent observations from the original issue scope
expectations.evidence: Separates both plugin inheritance and startup behavior from the original browser boundary.

expectations.text: Recommends approval when the in-scope security fix is sound
expectations.evidence: Explicitly recommends approval if Origin, Host, and cookie enforcement are correct.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions directly test the motivating classification boundary.
